newsitem.title: UK: Ldn freight-N Pacific cloudier for Panamax owners.
newsitem.headline: Ldn freight-N Pacific cloudier for Panamax owners.

text.p: The Panamax picture looked cloudier for owners in the North Pacific on Thursday.
The North Atlantic has already weakened quickly for Panamaxes this week but brokers reported a good volume of fresh chartering enquiry this morning for December loading.

The Caper market has shown no particular trend although conditions are described as quieter. Craned tonnage is believed to be in better demand from the Continent but there has been no appreciable improvement for owners elsewhere.

Contrary to Wednesday's reports, Tradigrain fixed Tigris for 75,000/5 barley from Rouen and Dunkirk to Jeddah at $17.75, option Dammam at $20.25. Dreyfus quoted a fresh enquiry for tonnage for 65,000 barley from the Continent to Saudi Arabia. Iranian chaerers were linked with a 1977-built panamax delivery Casablanca end Nov for a trip via Brazil to Iran at $11,000 daily, and a 1996-built vessel for 65,000 wheat Vancouver-Prince Rupert/Iran for Dec loading at $18.00.

Toepfer quoted an enquiry for prompt tonnage up to Caper size for barley from Canadian Pacific to Iran. In the Atlantic the 1978-built Petroplis 60,970 dwt was fixed delivery Skaw end Nov for a trip to the Far East at $13,000 daily but failed on subjects, and the 1990-built Aleabalo 70,402 dwt for similar business at $13,500 daily.

Auk 65,000 dwt was booked by Continental for grain business from US Gulf to the Med, possibly including Turkey. Although some brokers were pessimistic about prospects for owners in the Atlantic a number of fresh Panamax orders were seen. Cargill fixed 50,000/5 maize etc US Gulf/S Africa and delivery US Gulf mid Dec trip Far East, Bunge 2.5/3m cft Mississippi to Holland for Nov 27/Dec 10 (ideas $12.75 basis 55'), Ritco 62/74,000 dwt delery US Gulf Dec 5/15 trip Arabian Gulf, and Goldbeam US Gulf/Japan for Dec 1/14. Meanwhile MSK were said to be indicating $22.50 no combo for their 52-54,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Japan for Dec 16/23 against an owner at $23.00.

Minoan Sky 54,424 dwt and Atlantic Pride 64,473 dwt prompt US Gulf and Continent respectively were understood fixed on private terms. The Pioneer-relet Ascona was said to have been fixed for grain from ECSA to the Continent but details were not available

In the Pacific rumours circulated that a grain house had fixed a mid-1980's Panamax delivery NoPac trip Far East at close to $11,000 daily plus $175,000 bonus. This equates to under $10,000 daily for the round voyage and compares with NSAC's reported fixture Wednesday of the 1984-built space 69,675 dwt delivery NoPac early Dec trip Taiwan at $12,200 daily plus $210,000 bonus. There was also talk of similar tonnage reducing rate indications from $11,500 daily for Pacific rounds to $11,000 daily aps NoPac plus $200,000 bonus.

Apart from reports of Toepfer covering 23,000 grains UK/Italy at $16.00 and Andre 21,000 Rouen/Morocco at $12.25 both for end Nov few Handy-size grain fixtures were seen. But there were several new enquiries: Richardson 10/15,000 54' Thunder Bay/ARA end Nov, Dreyfus 15,000 wheat Duluth/Turkish Med end Nov, Andre 13,000 wheat St Lawrence/Puerto Cabello early Dec and 17/21,000 wheat Rouen/Morocco end Nov and Continental 10/15,000 maize prompt French Bay/Spanish Med. Continental were also quoting 33,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Indonesia for Dec 6/18, Lorico 22/25,000 corn Mississippi/Aqaba for Dec 5/10, Toepfer 25,000 wheat Up River/Tunisia for Dec 6/16 and Andre 15,000 meals Up River/Labuan and Kuching for Nov/Dec. The Australian wheat board fixed Anangel Horizon 27,000 dwt delivery prompt Singapore trip via Australia and Arabian Gulf redelivery Muscat at $6,300 daily.

Caper fixtures believed completed but not yet made public include China Prosperity 151,013 dwt delivery prompt Gibraltar trip via Chile to Indonesia, Lowlands Trassey 163,554 dwt delivery Far East for a Pacific Round (possibly at about $15,500 daily to Showa), and Total with a Caper for coal from Richards Bay to Rotterdam for early Jan at about $6.00/6.25. Carboex were linked with Elcano tonnage for about 90,000 coal Davant/ Tarragona at $8.00/8.50 for Dec 20/30 and Ruhrkoh with Bona Fountain for 65,000/10 Norfolk/Rotterdam at $7.00/7.25 for Dec 10/16. Anangel Venture 69,406 dwt was understood fixed Richards Bay/German North Sea on private terms and reports that Unitramp fixed a Panamax Richards Bay/Aarhus at about $9.50 were possibly old. Maratha Mighty 72,800 dwt was reported fixed delivery ex yard Keelung end Nov for a trip via Bunbury to Richards Bay by Sanko at $7,900 daily, and Northern Light 64,557 dwt may have been booked by Goldbeam for salt from W australia to USEC. In the fertilizer trades Noble fixed Helen B for 50,000 dap US Gulf/China at $24.50 for end Nov but there were rumours of Klaveness fixing similar business for mid Dec at only $22.00. x
